content: DESTINATION-REF in the VSMD The DESTINATION- REF in the VSMD shall point to the standardized AUTOSAR short-name path (e.g. /AUTOSAR/EcucDefs/Can/CanController) if the reference definition has an 225 of 295  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 87: AUTOSAR_TPS_ECUConfiguration Specification of ECU Configuration AUTOSAR CP R19-11 STMD counterpart. In this case the vendor specific short-name path (e.g. /Ven- dorX/Can) shall not be used. Example 4.4 shows a DESTINATION-REF from the CanIf module provided from VendorX to the CanDrv module provided by VendorY. The DESTINATION-REF content is not changed from "/AUTOSAR/EcucDefs/..." in the VSMD.
